overview.description: The Corgi U.S. Mid-Cap 2x Daily ETF (USMX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in mid cap equity. The fund uses swap agreements and other financial instruments to pursue 2x leveraged exposure to the daily performance of the Vanguard Mid-Cap  ETF (VO), before fees and expenses. The fund does not aim to achieve 2x of the underlying ETF for any period other than a single day. USMX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
